ValidationRule.description: The Evergreen and Renewable bundle cannot coexist in a bundle
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(AND(ISPICKVAL( ConfiguredSKU__r.SubscriptionType__c , 'Evergreen'), ISPICKVAL( OptionalSKU__r.SubscriptionType__c ,'Renewable')),AND(ISPICKVAL( ConfiguredSKU__r.SubscriptionType__c , 'Renewable'),ISPICKVAL( OptionalSKU__r.SubscriptionType__c ,'Evergreen'))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can’t include evergreen and renewable products in the same bundle.
